data.name: Bheema
data.gender_notes: Bheema is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bheema is a powerful and strong character in Hindu mythology, known for his immense strength and intelligence. In the epic Mahabharata, he is the elder brother of the Pandava brothers and an ally of Yudhishthira, the righteous eldest brother. The name Bheema carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bheema usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bheema belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bheema total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
